title: Embracing Uncertainty: Decoupling and De-Bias for Robust Temporal Grounding

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: Meanwhile, modified feature assigned with style-like words (including adjectives, adverbs, etc) represents the subjective information, and thus brings personalized predictions; De-bias -- We propose a de-bias mechanism to generate diverse predictions, aim to alleviate the bias caused by single-style annotations in the presence of label uncertainty.

problems.name: Uncertainty, Calibration, and Rejection
problems.evidence_sentence: Embracing Uncertainty: Decoupling and De-Bias for Robust Temporal Grounding Temporal grounding aims to localize temporal boundaries within untrimmed videos by language queries, but it faces the challenge of two types of inevitable human uncertainties: query uncertainty and label uncertainty.
